children: EBR Systems' bull at Bell Potter thinks the wireless pacemaker developer will need to raise more capital than previously envisioned. Analyst Martyn Jacobs had already anticipated a capital raise in mid-2027, but tells clients in a note that disappointing sales suggest the company will need additional equity after that. He lowers his fiscal 2026 sales forecast by 21% to US$10.8 million, and cuts volume expectations through his forecast period. Bell Potter keeps a speculative buy rating on the stock but slashes its target price by 71% to 0.20 Australian dollars. Shares are up 3.2% at A$0.16. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
